I haven’t been paying attention on this one too much.

top_reply.text: Yeah I get that — it’s annoying when you just want to build and they keep pushing prebuilt stuff. You might like OpenMonoAgent.ai, it’s built for people who want to make their own single-purpose model instead of being locked into someone else’s.
